## Summary
Explain the user-visible or system-level change in 2-4 lines.

## Problem
Describe the concrete issue, gap, or requirement this PR addresses.

## Solution
Explain the implementation approach and the main tradeoffs.

## Validation
List the exact commands, checks, or manual flows you ran.

## Risks
Call out residual risks, follow-up work, or areas reviewers should inspect carefully.
